name: nutriva-premium-nutrition-platform
description: NUTRIVA - Precision Nutrition for High-Performance Living (Full-Stack React + Vite & Node.js)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build && node -e "fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'dist', {recursive: true}); if(fs.existsSync('dist/_redirects')) fs.unlinkSync('dist/_redirects'); if(fs.existsSync('frontend/dist/_redirects')) fs.unlinkSync('frontend/dist/_redirects');"
